mentions.name: Chipmunkify
mentions.description: This web app lets users upload a song and generates a 'chipmunk' version of it by isolating the vocals and pitch-shifting them, while keeping the instrumentals untouched.
mentions.source_excerpt: A fun project I'm working on: Chipmunkify. You upload a song and it isolates the vocals to give you a 'chipmunk' version while keeping the instrumentals untouched.
